Read a BC Data Catalogue layer

Source: R/bag_bcdc_read.R
bag_bcdc_read.Rd

A convenience wrapper on bcdata::bcdc_query_geodata() and bcdata::collect(). Queries a catalogue record, optionally filters it on one column, optionally keeps only named columns, cleans the column names, and optionally drops the geometry.

Usage

bag_bcdc_read(
  bcdata_record_id,
  col_extract = NULL,
  drop_geom = FALSE,
  col_filter = NULL,
  col_filter_value = NULL
)

Arguments

bcdata_record_id

character The catalogue record, given as its permanent id ("7ecfafa6-5e18-48cd-8d9b-eae5b5ea2881"), its record name ("pscis-assessments") or its object name ("WHSE_FISH.PSCIS_ASSESSMENT_SVW"). Record names are listed at https://catalogue.data.gov.bc.ca/. Case is not significant: an id containing a . is upper-cased and one without is lower-cased.

col_extract

character Columns to keep. NULL (default) keeps all of them. Case is not significant.

drop_geom

logical Drop the geometry column from the returned sf object. Default FALSE.

col_filter

character A single column to filter on. NULL (default) applies no filter. Case is not significant.

col_filter_value

character The values to keep in col_filter. Required when col_filter is given.

Value

An sf object with cleaned names, or a tibble::tibble when drop_geom is TRUE.

See also

bag_bcdc_index() for finding a record's object name, and bag_bcdc() to write a catalogue layer straight to a GeoPackage instead of returning it.

Other catalogue: bag_bcdc(), bag_bcdc_cols(), bag_bcdc_index()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
bag_bcdc_read(
  bcdata_record_id = "7ecfafa6-5e18-48cd-8d9b-eae5b5ea2881",
  col_filter = "FUNDING_PROJECT_NUMBER",
  col_filter_value = "skeena_2023_Phase1",
  col_extract = c("EXTERNAL_CROSSING_REFERENCE", "STREAM_CROSSING_ID"),
  drop_geom = TRUE
)

# every record, two columns
bag_bcdc_read(
  bcdata_record_id = "bc-airports",
  col_extract = c("AIRPORT_NAME", "DESCRIPTION")
)
} # }
